name: newbyzantium
title: New Byzantium
for: H9 (The Specialists on Xash, BSP2): tsrp roleplay

style.theme: regal Byzantine dystopia: gold, dark marble, cement, stone-and-gold pillars, degrading going down

note: Three stacked layers on a 120 x 120-cell (15,360-unit) square, built in nine 40-cell tiles (the Core tile holds the Nexus). Top (L3): the Mese and the Nexus, Spire Heights' manors, Palace Row, Ministry Court. Middle (L2): Gate Ward with the front gate, the Bazaar, the Stacks, Hearth Ward, the Foundry, Lantern Row. Bottom (L1): the Drains, the Canal with its huts, the Hollow (the insurgents). 64 homes, 29 enterable buildings (10/10/9), roads for vehicles on every layer, the Mese 8 cells (25 m) wide with porticoes, 33 connectors (7 lifts) so the p90 walk to one is 14 cells (45 m) at most, the upper city gated (every public way up under one of 12 MSR checkpoints) joined to the Nexus by short service hallways, 27 secrets.

grid.note: 1 cell = 128 units = 3.25 m; a storey 192 units floor to floor; cell [60, 60] is the world origin

players.note: build for 64 (the engine runs 32 today; 64 planned)

spawns.where: public plazas and streets, clear of doors (560 units apart)

wiring.note: lamps, TVs, radios, club music, the city alarm said from the Nexus and every checkpoint

vehicle.system: OPTIONAL, UNBUILT DEPENDENCY: H9 has no car model and no driving code (both would be built game-side, outside SMAK). The roads only reserve room for an APC-class car (128 x 320 x 128 units, 512 turning radius, grades <= 0.15, garages); nothing in the city depends on cars: every place is reached on foot and every layer pair is joined without its ramp.

tiles.note: c0..c2 west to east, r0..r2 south to north; each tile is built, budgeted and rebuilt alone; seams cross only at the portals

layers.name: The Undercity
layers.note: vaulted sewers and the canal; light shafts to the street above at the basins

layers.name: The Common City
layers.note: roofed by the upper deck in the middle, a night sky round it; the ring's sky raised to z 28 with L3's (decided 2026-11-02): the deck's edge stands as a 7-cell cliff over the ring, the city wall's towers and the backdrop cards rise into the air between the wall and the lid (notes-megastructure.md F8, F20, F21)

layers.name: The Upper City
layers.note: the deck over the middle of the city, open to the dystopian night; z 20 stays the top of what is built and walked (storeys, monuments), the sky lid stands at z 28 (decided 2026-11-02) so towers, domes and spires rise past the old flat cap

frame-cement.look: board-marked structural cement of the mega-structure's frame: deck piers, girders, coffers, the deck's soffit and edge, stained by the drips of the city above; one material in every district of L1 and L2 (notes-megastructure.md M20)

frame-marble-gold.look: the regime's frame on the upper city: dark marble with gold bands on the deck's parapet, the edge piers' crowns and the Nexus spine's drum (notes-megastructure.md M20; the MSR's purple and gold unchanged)

stone-gold-pillar.look: stone column with gold capital and bands (the city's thread, kept from the upper levels)

regal-window.look: arched windows, gold mullions, purple glass

cement-polished.look: polished cement wall, gold inlay lines

stone-pillar-plain.look: plain stone pillar, the gold worn off

neon-tile-wall.look: glossy tile wall lit by neon

hut-curtain.look: hut door of planks and cloth

buildings.name: The MSR Nexus

tower.note: the city's landmark (H9's own maps show a round tower): a round shaft of 7 cells (23 m) on the Nexus's roof, on the Mese's axis, seven storeys over the three enterable ones, its crown at z 27 (12 + 10 storeys of 1.5), a cell (3.25 m) under the raised sky lid at z 28 and within dimensions.towers.topClearance (1.28 m, so 27.6 at most). Why seven (2026-11-02, the sky raised from 20 to 28): it is the capital's landmark and the regime's, so it is the tallest thing in the city by a clear margin: 15 cells (48.8 m) over the Forum's floor and 27 (87.8 m) over the Undercity's, the Hagia Sophia's crown (about 55 m) at game scale x1.5; every other L3 silhouette stays at least two storeys under it (notes-megastructure.md M13); and it fills the new lid without touching it, so the sky still reads over its crown. A shell, not enterable: 10 brushes (3 and one a storey) of dimensions.towers.maxBrushes 24

buildings.note: the MSR's headquarters and jail; a spine on all three layers (its lifts and stair to the precinct and the cistern); hallways out to every checkpoint. R2 (room caps, pockets): with every MSR room kind capped from data (roomKinds maxArea) its three storeys of about 950 m2 held more floor than their rooms could take, left as terraces of 200 and 290 m2 on the upper storeys, so the program gains an office, a third interrogation room and a second evidence room (each room some 8 brushes of the tile's estimate: the Core keeps its 5 % reserve, forms.reserveShare); what is left over its rooms' caps stage 5 leaves unbuilt (in the Core a terrace of about 190 m2 on the top storey, a 40 m2 closed void and two small loggias on the jail storey, corridor bays off the halls); the footprint stays, the tower stands on it
